problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns use personalized information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Educate employees on recognizing social engineering tactics
Verify unusual requests through secondary communication channels

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees or partners.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Establish strict verification procedures for financial transactions
Monitor email account activity for anomalies and unauthorized access

problems.description: Misconfigured cloud storage services (e.g., S3 buckets, Azure Blob storage) expose sensitive data publicly or to unauthorized users.
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Attackers infiltrate organizations by compromising software or hardware suppliers, injecting malicious code or backdoors into trusted components.
risk_reduction: Conduct rigorous vendor risk assessments
Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) tracking
Monitor for anomalous behavior in third-party integrations

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model parameters to degrade AI system performance or cause incorrect outputs.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Employ robust model validation and anomaly detection
Use secure model update and deployment pipelines

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio, video) to impersonate trusted individuals and deceive targets for fraud or espionage.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor and out-of-band verification
Raise awareness of deepfake risks among employees
Deploy deepfake detection technologies

problems.description: Malware that operates in memory without writing files to disk, evading traditional antivirus detection.
risk_reduction: Deploy behavior-based endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools
Monitor for anomalous process and memory activity
Apply least privilege and application control policies
